title: Swain Sequel (Reaction → Dilemma → Decision)
description: Swain sequel scene: emotional reaction to a disaster, wrestling with an impossible dilemma, leading to a new decision.
systemPromptDirective: Focus on internal processing following a setback: visceral emotional response, deliberate weighing of painful options, culminating in a resolute decision.

fields.label: Emotional Reaction
fields.placeholder: e.g., Shock and grief as the safehouse burns, numbness giving way to panic
fields.helperText: Visceral, emotional, and physical aftermath of the previous disaster

fields.label: The Dilemma
fields.placeholder: e.g., Surrender to the authorities and lose the code, or dive into the radioactive sewers
fields.helperText: A choice between two bad alternatives or equally risky sacrifices

fields.label: New Decision
fields.placeholder: e.g., Enter the sewers to find the rogue engineer before dawn
fields.helperText: The active commitment that propels the character into the next action scene
